svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. There is no green rail because budgets are never cached in Redis.
The only Redis traffic on this route is the report cache (report:<userId>, 1 h TTL), invalidated and repopulated by refreshReport as a side effect of the write.
